hunks.baseline: For a moment, I couldn’t understand it. The words that had come from the mouth of a young man with an unfamiliar face tangled together in my head.
hunks.sol: For a moment, I couldn’t make sense of it. The words that had come from the unfamiliar young man’s mouth tangled together in my head.

hunks.baseline: Memories etched deep into my mind surfaced before vanishing again.
hunks.sol: Memories etched deep into my mind surfaced, then vanished.

hunks.baseline: Jongni Chu disappearing in the middle of the duel. Hong Dao gasping at death’s door. And the four words he had left as his final message.
hunks.sol: Jongni Chu disappearing in the middle of the duel. Hong Dao gasping at death’s door. And the four words he had left behind as his final message.

hunks.baseline: What, exactly, had everything I had seen and heard until now meant?
hunks.sol: What, exactly, had everything I’d seen and heard until now meant?

hunks.baseline: Where had it all begun, and how had it unfolded?
hunks.sol: Where and how had it all gone wrong?

hunks.baseline: I stood frozen like a stone statue, desperately trying to grasp the thread connecting everything. But before I could put my thoughts in order, a dry voice slipped between Jeok Cheongang’s lips.
hunks.sol: I stood frozen like a statue, desperately trying to grasp the thread connecting everything. But before I could put my thoughts in order, a dry voice escaped Jeok Cheongang’s lips.

hunks.baseline: “You killed Hong Dao?”
hunks.sol: “You… killed… Hong Dao?”

hunks.baseline: His words came in broken fragments, soaked in patience, rage, and disbelief.
hunks.sol: Each word came out separately, strained with restraint, rage, and disbelief.

hunks.baseline: At the sight of Jeok Cheongang, the young man smiled faintly and nodded.
hunks.sol: The young man smiled faintly at Jeok Cheongang and nodded.

hunks.baseline: “Why do people lie? Because there are idiots who occasionally fall for it.”
hunks.sol: “Why do people lie? Because every now and then, some idiot falls for it.”

hunks.baseline: Blood dripped from Jeok Cheongang’s fist as he clenched it hard enough to crush something.
hunks.sol: Blood dripped from Jeok Cheongang’s fist as he clenched it tight enough to crush bone.

hunks.baseline: “He wasn’t fooled. He let himself be fooled. That was the kind of person Hong Dao was.”
hunks.sol: “He wasn’t fooled. He allowed himself to be fooled. That was the kind of man Hong Dao was.”

hunks.baseline: “He let himself be fooled? I suppose that’s possible. If you say he was trying to prevent some unforeseen slaughter because he was a bald bastard who happened to be the Abbot of Shaolin, it sounds plausible.”
hunks.sol: “He allowed himself to be fooled? I suppose that’s possible. He was the damned Abbot of Shaolin, after all. Saying he wanted to prevent even the slightest chance of a massacre would make sense.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t give me too much grief. I hadn’t planned anything this shoddy, either. But things became tangled in a place I never expected. Of course, you had something to do with that, too…”
hunks.sol: “Don’t give me too much grief. I hadn’t planned anything this shoddy, either. But things went wrong where I least expected them to. Of course, part of that was because of…”

hunks.baseline: The young man’s gaze suddenly shifted toward me.
hunks.sol: The young man’s gaze shifted toward me.

hunks.baseline: “Jin Taekyung, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi. You played your part.”
hunks.sol: “The Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi, Jin Taekyung. You played your part.”

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know whether it was because of the hostility I felt toward him or because I could sense the overwhelming difference in power between us.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know whether it was because of my hostility toward him or because I could sense the overwhelming difference in power between us.

hunks.baseline: “Because you suddenly joined the duel, I had to move the plan forward by a day. The biggest variable among them was the Always-Victorious Sword, Jongni Chu.”
hunks.sol: “You barged into the duel, forcing me to move the plan forward by a day. The biggest complication was that bastard, the Always-Victorious Sword Jongni Chu.”

hunks.baseline: “Well, in the end, everything was taken care of neatly.”
hunks.sol: “Well, everything worked out neatly in the end.”

hunks.baseline: “The sacred treasure of Shaolin—the Green Jade Buddha Staff.”
hunks.sol: “Shaolin’s sacred treasure—the Green Jade Buddha Staff.”

hunks.baseline: His wrinkled hand was still holding on to the staff.
hunks.sol: Han Su’s wrinkled hand was still gripping the staff.

hunks.baseline: “A request? Go ahead and tell me. You worked hard, so I’ll do my utmost to grant it.”
hunks.sol: “A request? Go ahead. You worked hard, so I’ll do my utmost to grant it.”

hunks.baseline: And it was even stranger because that old man was the great demonic fiend who had turned Shaolin Temple into a river of blood.
hunks.sol: Even more so when that old man was the infamous demonic fiend who had turned Shaolin Temple into a river of blood.

hunks.baseline: *What the hell is that bastard’s identity?*
hunks.sol: *Who the hell is that bastard?*

hunks.baseline: His status within Dark Heaven was unimaginably high, or he was much older than he looked.
hunks.sol: Either his status within Dark Heaven was unimaginably high, or he was much older than he looked.

hunks.baseline: Whatever the case, Han Su’s face brightened at the young man’s answer.
hunks.sol: Whatever the case, Han Su’s face brightened at the answer from the young man called the Blood Lord.

hunks.baseline: “Have you spent your whole life being deceived? You completed your mission perfectly, so a Reward is only natural. But I wonder what kind of difficult request our Senior Yin Ghost is taking so long to bring up.”
hunks.sol: “Have you spent your whole life being deceived? You completed your mission perfectly, so a reward is only natural. But what kind of difficult request has our Senior Yin Ghost hesitating like this?”

hunks.baseline: “But it’s difficult for you to do yourself?”
hunks.sol: “But it’s difficult for you to handle yourself?”

hunks.baseline: “Ah. I have a rough idea what it is.”
hunks.sol: “Ah. I think I know what it is.”

hunks.baseline: “You want me to kill those two, don’t you? Is that it?”
hunks.sol: “You want me to kill those two, don’t you? Am I right?”

hunks.baseline: Han Su nodded with killing intent in his eyes.
hunks.sol: Han Su nodded, his eyes filled with killing intent.

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord gave a short laugh.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord let out a short laugh.

hunks.baseline: “He was at my side for half a lifetime. I will not be satisfied with anything less.”
hunks.sol: “He was at my side for half my life. Nothing less will satisfy me.”

hunks.baseline: “Loyalty… Well, that is good, too.”
hunks.sol: “Loyalty… Well, that’s admirable in its own way.”

hunks.baseline: “Will that be enough? If the orthodox faction comes swarming in, things will become troublesome. If we want to finish quickly and leave, you’ll have to sweat a little, Senior.”
hunks.sol: “Will that be enough? If the orthodox faction comes swarming in, things will get troublesome. If we want to finish quickly and leave, you’ll have to work up a little sweat too, Senior.”

hunks.baseline: “You take the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi. I’ll take the Fire King. We should be able to finish within an ildagyeong at the latest.”[^2]
hunks.sol: “You take the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi. I’ll take the Fire King. We should be finished within an ildagyeong at the latest.”[^2]

hunks.baseline: Their conversation was absurd. They spoke of our lives as if they were objects in their pockets.
hunks.sol: Their conversation was absurd. They spoke of our lives as though they were objects already tucked inside their pockets.

hunks.baseline: The way Jeok Cheongang’s face had stiffened proved that those words were not mere boasting.
hunks.sol: The way Jeok Cheongang’s face had stiffened proved that his words were no empty boast.

hunks.baseline: —If the situation becomes unfavorable, run.
hunks.sol: —If things turn against us, run.

hunks.baseline: A fierce battle was already raging above us. We could not expect help from Shaolin.
hunks.sol: A fierce battle was already raging above us. We couldn’t expect help from Shaolin.

hunks.baseline: If I withdrew, Jeok Cheongang would have no choice but to face the concentrated assault of two Supreme Peak masters.
hunks.sol: If I pulled out, Jeok Cheongang would have no choice but to face the combined assault of two Supreme Peak masters.

hunks.baseline: *The best course is to hold out here until the very end.*
hunks.sol: *Our best option is to hold out here until the very end.*

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang knew that, too.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang knew that too.

hunks.baseline: And yet he had told me to run because he was warmer and more concerned than people realized.
hunks.sol: And yet he had told me to run because he was warmer and worried more than anyone realized.

hunks.baseline: *This is going to be genuinely dangerous this time.*
hunks.sol: *This time, we might really be in trouble.*

hunks.baseline: I licked my parched lips and gripped White Flame tightly.
hunks.sol: I licked my parched lips and tightened my grip on White Flame.

hunks.baseline: “Pathetic fool. Do you think anything will change because you hold that? Your attainment is commendable, but even if you died and came back to life, you could never defeat this old man.”
hunks.sol: “Pathetic fool. Do you think that will change anything? Your attainment is impressive enough, but even if you died and came back to life, you could never defeat this old man.”

hunks.baseline: I spat a wad of phlegm onto the ground for all to see.
hunks.sol: I spat a wad of phlegm onto the ground where he could see it.

hunks.baseline: “Give me a few shichen of sleep in this world, and when I wake up, you’ll die by my hand.”
hunks.sol: “Give me a few shichen of solid sleep in this world, and when I wake up, you’ll die by my hand.”

hunks.baseline: “If you don’t believe me, test it.”
hunks.sol: “If you don’t believe me, put it to the test.”

hunks.baseline: “How dare this green little brat!”
hunks.sol: “How dare you, you green little brat!”

hunks.baseline: It was unfortunate.
hunks.sol: It was a damn shame.

hunks.baseline: If I hadn’t been in the middle of a battle, and if time stopped completely when I used Logout instead of merely slowing down, I could have used an infinite amount of time to escape this crisis.
hunks.sol: If I hadn’t been in the middle of a battle, and if time stopped completely when I used Logout instead of merely slowing down, I could have used all the time in the world to escape this crisis.

hunks.baseline: But those thoughts were nothing more than personal wishful thinking.
hunks.sol: But that was nothing more than wishful thinking.

hunks.baseline: Now was the time to face reality, not indulge in delusions.
hunks.sol: Now was the time to face reality, not indulge in fantasies.

hunks.baseline: Now I understood exactly why that damned old man was known as the Yin Ghost.
hunks.sol: Now I understood exactly why that damned old man was called the Yin Ghost.

hunks.baseline: The ground froze beneath every step he took, and frost settled over the branches of the trees.
hunks.sol: The ground froze beneath every step he took, and frost settled over the branches.

hunks.baseline: “What vicious Yin-Cold Earth Qi. But…”
hunks.sol: “What vicious Yin-Cold Qi. But…”

hunks.baseline: “You dare not lay a hand on my Disciple.”
hunks.sol: “A bastard like you will not lay a hand on my Disciple.”

hunks.baseline: If Han Su’s Yin-Cold Earth Qi was an iceberg, Jeok Cheongang’s Scorching Yang Qi was the sun.
hunks.sol: If Han Su’s Yin-Cold Qi was an iceberg, Jeok Cheongang’s Scorching Yang Qi was the sun.

hunks.baseline: If Flame Tiger’s martial arts had truly been equal to Han Su’s, then Jeok Cheongang’s overwhelming victory had been inevitable.
hunks.sol: Assuming Flame Tiger and Han Su were equals in martial prowess, Jeok Cheongang’s overwhelming victory had been inevitable.

hunks.baseline: But Han Su’s expression was relaxed.
hunks.sol: But Han Su looked perfectly at ease.

hunks.baseline: “Blood Lord, you will have to step forward.”
hunks.sol: “Blood Lord, I will need you to step in.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. We should get started.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. It’s about time we got started.”

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord tucked the Green Jade Buddha Staff into his robes as carefully as if it were a priceless treasure.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord tucked the Green Jade Buddha Staff into his robes as carefully as a priceless treasure.

hunks.baseline: And in the next moment—
hunks.sol: And in the next instant—

hunks.baseline: Along with a horrifying sound, a round object flew through the air and rolled to a stop at my feet.
hunks.sol: A round object flew through the air with a sickening sound and rolled to a stop at my feet.

hunks.baseline: White hair. A dignified-looking face. A faint smile still lingered around the mouth.
hunks.sol: White hair. Dignified features. A faint smile still lingering around the mouth.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang and I widened our eyes at the same time.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s eyes widened along with mine.

hunks.baseline: Han Su, the infamous great demonic fiend and Supreme Peak master known as the Yin Ghost, had been beheaded in a single strike.
hunks.sol: Han Su—the infamous demonic fiend and Supreme Peak master known as the Yin Ghost—had been beheaded in a single strike.

hunks.baseline: By the hand of the ally he had trusted without question.
hunks.sol: By the ally he had trusted without question.

hunks.baseline: Unlike Jeok Cheongang and me, who stood frozen in shock, the Blood Lord—the one responsible for everything—was perfectly calm.
hunks.sol: Unlike us, the Blood Lord—the one responsible for everything—remained perfectly calm.

hunks.baseline: “Fucking old man. This is why you should never take in people with no roots.”
hunks.sol: “Fucking old man. This is why you should never take in rootless trash.”

hunks.baseline: He clicked his tongue and casually nudged Han Su’s headless body.
hunks.sol: Clicking his tongue, he casually nudged Han Su’s headless body.

hunks.baseline: “If you’re a sword, act like a sword. Go wherever the person holding you swings you. How dare you…”
hunks.sol: “If you’re a sword, act like one. Cut wherever your wielder points you. How dare you…!”

hunks.baseline: His kicks, loaded with internal energy, tore through flesh and crushed bone.
hunks.sol: His kicks, loaded with internal energy, tore through flesh and shattered bone.

hunks.baseline: After stamping and grinding Han Su’s lifeless corpse beneath his feet several times, the Blood Lord swept his fallen hair back.
hunks.sol: After repeatedly stamping and grinding Han Su’s lifeless corpse beneath his feet, the Blood Lord swept his fallen hair back.

hunks.baseline: “There are always people who don’t know their place. They don’t know how strong they are or how far they should stick their necks out. Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi, don’t you agree?”
hunks.sol: “There are always people who don’t know their place. They don’t know their own level or when they should stay out of things. Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi, don’t you agree?”

hunks.baseline: “You’re still a young brat yourself, and you already seem a little unhinged.”
hunks.sol: “You’re still young yourself, and you already seem a little unhinged.”

hunks.baseline: “Thank you for thinking of me as young. I’m older than I look.”
hunks.sol: “Thank you for thinking I’m young. I’m older than I look.”

hunks.baseline: “Not that old.”
hunks.sol: “How old could you possibly be?”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t push it. I’ve lived at least twice as long as you have.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t be so sure. I’ve lived at least twice as long as you have.”

hunks.baseline: I looked him up and down with disbelief.
hunks.sol: I looked him up and down in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: His face made him look like an inexperienced young man in his early to mid-twenties at most.
hunks.sol: His face made him look like some inexperienced young man in his early to mid-twenties at most.

hunks.baseline: This could not be explained simply by calling him youthful-looking.
hunks.sol: This went far beyond merely looking young.

hunks.baseline: But if there was anywhere that anything could happen, it was the Murim.
hunks.sol: But if there was anywhere something like this could happen, it was the Murim.

hunks.baseline: “What? Surprised because I’m much older than you expected?”
hunks.sol: “What? Surprised I’m so much older than you expected?”

hunks.baseline: “No. If what you’re saying is true, I was thinking you’re a bastard who doesn’t act his age.”
hunks.sol: “No. If that’s true, I was thinking you’re a bastard who really doesn’t act his age.”

hunks.baseline: His behavior and speech were light—so light they bordered on frivolous.
hunks.sol: His behavior, his tone—everything about him was light, almost frivolous.

hunks.baseline: And that was precisely why he felt even more dangerous.
hunks.sol: That only made him feel more dangerous.

hunks.baseline: Even now, as he bent forward laughing, I could not see the slightest opening.
hunks.sol: Even now, bent over with laughter and his shoulders shaking, he showed not the slightest opening.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, who had been glaring at him as his shoulders shook, suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang glared at him before abruptly speaking.

hunks.baseline: “He was a rusty sword. Its usefulness had run out, so disposing of it was only natural.”
hunks.sol: “He was a rusty sword. His usefulness had run out, so disposing of him was only natural.”

hunks.baseline: “You are worth rating highly, Fire King. If the Great Faction War had continued for one more year, you probably would have become one of the Four Saints instead of merely one of the Three Saints.”
hunks.sol: “You’re worth rating highly, Fire King. If the Great Faction War had continued for one more year, you probably would have become one of the Four Saints instead of the Three Saints.”

hunks.baseline: “Looks like my edge has not gone dull yet.”
hunks.sol: “Then it seems my edge has not gone dull yet.”

hunks.baseline: “You are good enough to be called a fine sword.”
hunks.sol: “You’re more than worthy of being called a fine sword.”

hunks.baseline: “What would happen if that fine sword were driven into your heart?”
hunks.sol: “What would happen if that fine sword pierced your heart?”

hunks.baseline: “Who knows… I’m sturdier than I look. I don’t think that would draw even a drop of blood.”
hunks.sol: “Who knows… I’m sturdier than I look. I doubt that would draw even a single drop of blood.”

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord smiled faintly as Jeok Cheongang’s eyes sank into darkness.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord smiled faintly as Jeok Cheongang’s gaze grew dark and still.

hunks.baseline: “Even if the culprit were a demon god instead of a human, I would see this revenge through to the end.”
hunks.sol: “Even if his killer were a demon god rather than a human, I would see this vengeance through to the end.”

hunks.baseline: “That is touching and all, but…”
hunks.sol: “That’s touching and all, but…”

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord’s smile vanished as he caressed the sword hilt at his waist.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord’s smile vanished as he caressed the hilt of the sword at his waist.

hunks.baseline: “What do you think of what he said?”
hunks.sol: “What do you think of that?”

hunks.baseline: “I think your mouth needs a circumcision. It’s been spewing nothing but dickhead bullshit since earlier.”
hunks.sol: “I think his mouth needs circumcising. It’s been spewing dick nonstop.”

hunks.baseline: “……You really are an interesting one.”
hunks.sol: “……You really are an interesting bastard.”

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord took one step toward Jeok Cheongang and me before suddenly speaking.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord took one step toward Jeok Cheongang and me, then suddenly spoke.

hunks.baseline: “But how long does that little rat hiding over there plan to stay hidden?”
hunks.sol: “But how long does that little rat over there plan to keep hiding?”

hunks.baseline: A strange man emerged from the distant grass and scratched the back of his head.
hunks.sol: A suspicious-looking figure emerged from the distant grass and scratched the back of his head.
